summary: The first-time player understood the controls quickly and enjoyed a smooth two-run session through Comet Walls, Zig-Zag comets, and Double Walls. The main friction points were multi-second delays on both 'SHIP DOWN' fail screens before any button or end card appeared.

items.title: 3-second delay before 'TRY AGAIN' button appears
items.evidence: At t=29.5s, the 'SHIP DOWN' screen appeared with Score 430 and 2.87 km, but no button was visible (S2, S7), resulting in 31% clarity and an ineffective input (S4). The 'TRY AGAIN' button did not appear until t=32.5s (S8).
items.suggestion: Show the 'TRY AGAIN' button immediately when the 'SHIP DOWN' screen appears (or within 0.5s) so players know right away how to start their second ship.

items.title: Dead-end 'Out of ships' screen before end card
items.evidence: After the second ship was destroyed at t=48.5s, the 'SHIP DOWN' screen displayed 'Out of ships' with no button or transition cue (S3, S9), yielding 22% clarity and contributing to a 4.5s idle gap (S6) before the end card appeared at t=51.0s (S10).
items.suggestion: Transition directly from the final ship explosion to the end card, or add a brief animated 'FINAL SCORE...' transition indicator on the 'Out of ships' screen.

items.title: Static end card with no idle motion
items.evidence: Between the 'Out of ships' screen and the end card at t=51.0s (S10), the session recorded 4.5s with no on-screen motion or input (S6).
items.suggestion: Add a subtle pulsing animation to the 'PLAY NOW' button and keep background stars drifting on the end card to draw attention to the CTA.
